text: ＊を　あずかって　＊を　もたせました！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: もつ 'to hold' becomes もたせる 'to make or let someone hold'. もたせました = 'gave it to hold'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions in order, like 'and then'. あずかって　…　もたせました = 'took it and gave it something to hold'.
